fact: In a notice of 28 September 2026 the digital ministry's WARDIP-GN project sought market views on a sovereign cloud for the Guinean state across two data centres, designed for reversibility and no vendor lock-in, with skills transfer to the state agency ANDE.
title: Avis d'engagement précoce du marché, Projet de Transformation Numérique pour l'Afrique (WARDIP-GN)
publisher: Ministère de la Communication, de l'Economie Numérique et de l'Innovation (MCENI)
